gate: RESOURCE_EVOLUTION_PILOT_V1 (T0-T10) - execution strategy under core / CPU / wall / RAM / speculation budgets, risk profiles and cue conditioning
invariant: Correctness is the entry condition, not a cost term. Only VERIFIED_RESULT is returned: an interval pass that reached T, DECIDED, effective p = requested p, cells re-derived from its exact endpoints by the independent verifier. Physics, constants, inputs, domain, rounding, acceptance rule never change. Selectors choose what to try first, never what is correct.

machine.smt_siblings: logical (2i, 2i+1) share physical core i (pre-seal probe: two burners on (0,1) 1.8x slower than on (0,2)); re-measured in T0 as evidence
machine.core_budget_k_means: the first k logical CPUs of physical_core_order (one per physical core); 6 is the maximum, so the handoff's {1,2,3,4,6} is used as is
machine.affinity: set by every worker as its first action (psutil), read back by the worker and by the parent, recorded

pre_seal_observations_disclosed: a single request is single-threaded (Python + mpmath): one request cannot use more than one core except by speculation or pair splitting
frozen P3 line + 0 already decides all 9 evaluation requests for algebra (from A2T/A3 minima), so 'aggressive' is defined at line - 16

evaluators.E2: rw:R1+R2 (A3 adapter; its S1-S6 + sympy gates are re-run in T0)

requests.EVAL: A2_bound, A3_low, A3_high x T 100, 1000, 3000 (9 requests); 5000/10000 excluded for cost
requests.COND (conditioning trials): EVAL requests with T 1000 and 3000, cycled in the order A2_bound@1000, A3_low@1000, A3_high@1000, A2_bound@3000, A3_low@3000, A3_high@3000

line: L(s,T) = ceil(a_s + b_s T) with the frozen A1 P3 lines (policy_hash 6d601462...)

plans (approved set).BASE: E1, 1 worker, start L+8 (= frozen P3), then the frozen P2 rule in the same worker
plans (approved set).CONS: E1, 1 worker, start L+24, then P2; conservative: high first-try success
plans (approved set).AGG1: E2, 1 worker, start L-16, then P2
plans (approved set).AGG3: E2, 3 concurrent workers at L-16, L, L+16 (speculative precision); the first DECIDED to finish is verified and accepted, the others are killed (their CPU is speculative waste); if none decides, P2 continues serially from the highest tried p
plans (approved set).SPEC_EVAL: E1 and E2 concurrently at L+8 (2 workers); first DECIDED accepted
plans (approved set).SPEC_P_E1: as AGG3 but evaluator E1 (T2 placement test isolates placement from the evaluator)

workers: one fresh process per worker, pinned to its logical CPU(s); workers of one request share the request's core set round-robin; more workers than cores = oversubscription (allowed for fixed plans, recorded)

budget_enforcement.cpu: the parent polls every worker's CPU every 50 ms; when the request's summed worker CPU reaches the CPU budget all workers are killed
budget_enforcement.wall: the same poll kills on the wall budget
budget_enforcement.ram: admission: workers x 150 MB > RAM budget -> RESOURCE_REFUSED before start; measured peak working set recorded and compared after the run (RAM_BUDGET_EXCEEDED flag)

statuses.RESOURCE_REFUSED: no completed failed attempt before the budget ran out or admission refused
statuses.BUDGET_STARVATION: at least one attempt completed without success and the budget ran out before a fallback could finish
statuses.NOT_VERIFIED: a DECIDED claim failed the verifier (must never be accepted)

calibration (phase CAL, before any evalu: BASE on TRAIN, 1 core, 3 repetitions. kappa_s = median over T in {200, 2000} and repetitions of (first-pass CPU / T); o = median over all CAL runs of (worker total CPU - pass CPU) = process start + imports + evaluator preparation. Predicted pass-equivalent u(s,T) = o + kappa_s * T (CPU seconds of one worker doing one pass).

tiers (per request; u from CAL).note: the stored record always carries the actual budgets (cores, CPU s, wall s, RAM MB, spec), never only a pressure label

selectors.FIXED_BASE: BASE always (does not read the environment)
selectors.ADAPTIVE: reads the visible environment only: if cores >= 3 and cpu_u >= 4 and spec >= 3 -> AGG3; elif cpu_u >= 2 -> BASE; else -> CONS
selectors.CONDITIONED: visible environment plentiful (H0 shown) -> AGG3, except: cue present and V[cue] > 0.5 -> CONS. V updated after every trial by Rescorla-Wagner V <- V + 0.3 (lambda - V) for each cue present, lambda = 1 if the trial's hidden budget was the pressure budget else 0 (the true budget is revealed only after the trial)
selectors.inputs_allowed: visible environment, cue ids, V table; never the request's minimum p, evaluation outcomes, verifier results of the current trial, or future schedule (checked by the checker from the logged selector input)

phases.T0: regression seal: (a) single passes at L+8 for the 6 short EVAL requests and A2_bound@3000 with E1 and E2 (E0 for A2_bound@100 and A3_high@100) on logical CPU 2 and again on CPU 8 -> identical endpoints, and equal to A1/A2T/A3 bundle passes where the same (evaluator, request, p) exists; (b) E2 gates re-run (A3 verify + sympy for rw:R1+R2); (c) SMT probe; (d) worker-count invariance from T1 (k = 1 vs 6 identical results)
phases.T1: S1 batch of the 9 EVAL requests, plan BASE (E1) and BASE-with-E2, cores k in {1,2,3,4,6}, 3 repetitions, order counterbalanced; plus A3_high@1000 BASE alone pinned to 1 vs 6 cores (3 repetitions)
phases.T2: S0 = T1 k=1, S1 = T1 k=6; S2 = SPEC_P_E1 on 3 cores vs BASE on 1 core per EVAL request; S3 = SPEC_EVAL on 2 cores; S4 = pair-parallel KDK prototype (3 persistent pair workers, canonical fixed-order reduction) vs the serial loop, A3_low and A3_high at T 100 and 1000, p 128, bit-identity required; S5 = execution/verification pipeline (5 executor cores + concurrent verifier) vs verify-after; 3 repetitions each
phases.T3_T4: per tier H0..H4 and EVAL request: FIXED_BASE, FIXED_AGG3, ADAPTIVE consecutively (order rotated), 1 repetition
phases.T5: neutral cue: 12 trials [A,-,A,A,-,A,A,-,A,A,-,A] (A = cue A, no pressure)
phases.T6: acquisition 16 trials [A+,-,A+,A+,-,A+,A+,-,A+,A+,-,A+,A+,-,A+,A+] (A+ = cue A with hidden pressure H3 CPU budget, cores still 6), then test 4 trials A without pressure
phases.conditioning_note: one CONDITIONED learner persists T5 -> T6 -> T7; every trial is also run by NO_LEARN on the same request and hidden budget
phases.T8: BASE, CONS, AGG1, AGG3 under H0 on the 9 EVAL requests, 3 repetitions, counterbalanced
phases.T9: per EVAL request: float64 candidate (same KDK and the algebra force in binary64) proposes cells -> verifier = BASE interval run; hit = equal cells; accepted result is always the verified interval result; fault injection: candidate cells + 1 must be rejected; Type B demonstration = float cells compared with verified cells (never accepted); Type A = E2 at L+8 with its domain refusal test
phases.T10: H1 (low), H2 (medium), H3 (high) x {AGG3, CONS} x 9 EVAL requests x 2 repetitions

latency_stats: p50 always; p95 only with n >= 20, p99 only with n >= 100 (else INSUFFICIENT_SAMPLES)
cost_axes: wall and total CPU (sum of worker CPU + orchestrator CPU) kept separate; retry CPU, speculative waste CPU (killed or unused workers), verify CPU, record CPU, peak working set; Pareto view, no single weighted score
checker: independent of the executor; re-verifies every accepted result from endpoints, cross-run RESULT_CONFLICT (including A1/A2T/A3 bundles), status consistency with budgets, CPU sanity (worker CPU <= cores x wall x 1.10 + 0.5 s per request), affinity within the allowed set, selector inputs within the allowed keys (leakage), Rescorla-Wagner values and every CONDITIONED choice re-derived, false accept = 0, completeness of every planned trial
not_in_scope: undervolting / overclocking / thermal or hardware fault experiments
physics, constants, domain or rounding changes
claims_forbidden: a conditioned response is general intelligence
an observed false-accept count of 0 is a proof
one long run decides a winner
amendment_1_before_any_run: u originally excluded the per-worker start/import overhead o although budgets are enforced on total worker CPU; T=100 requests would have been refused by overhead alone. Corrected before any CAL or evaluation run (no data existed).
